name: marker-highlight
description: A headline on the chapter field; words wrapped in *asterisks* get the yellow marker swipe. Optional sub line below in the field ink. Left-aligned (align:center only for the one centred moment of a video). Keep it ≤ 6 words. fit (default true): a word wider than the line shrinks the headline (down to 55% of size) instead of breaking mid-word; fit:false restores break-word wrapping. paper (default false): true puts the headline (and sub) on a paper scrap / circular lying on the field at a seeded tilt, tossed in on the cut frame, text in paper ink — use for quotes; ~120 size reads best since the scrap's padding narrows the line.
